post.summary: Refresh browser-derived upstream auth without changing Worker secrets
post.description: Stores short-lived browser-derived Fantasy402 authorization material in AUTH_CACHE. Values are never echoed in responses or diagnostics. The cached overlay takes effect before configured secrets and expires automatically.

400.description: Invalid JSON body or no supported auth fields

post.summary: Upload locally fetched Fantasy402 endpoint responses
post.description: Protected storage-only ingestion path for operator machines that can access Fantasy402 directly. The Worker archives supplied responses to R2 and records snapshots in D1; it does not fetch Fantasy402 for this route.

500.description: One or more local results failed to store

triggerToken.description: Manual ingestion trigger token stored as the configured runtime bearer secret.

cookieNames.description: Sanitized cookie names only; never includes cookie values.

status.description: Sanitized ingestion auth readiness derived from observed upstream auth shape.

blocker.description: Present only when scheduled upstream ingestion is blocked by missing browser auth material.

authorization.description: Browser-observed Authorization bearer value. The Worker normalizes missing Bearer prefix.

sessionCookie.description: Browser-observed non-Cloudflare application/session Cookie header fragment from an authenticated upstream browser request. Included in the upstream Cookie header alongside Cloudflare cookies; required for ingestion readiness because Cloudflare cookies alone can still yield upstream 403/1106.

cfClearance.description: Cloudflare cf_clearance cookie value or name=value pair.

cfBm.description: Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie value or name=value pair.

browserHeadersJson.description: JSON string containing allowlisted browser metadata headers.

browserHeaders.description: Allowlisted browser metadata headers. Cookie, authorization, host, content-type, and content-length remain controlled by Worker code.

customerId.description: Optional customer-scoped request identifier for endpoints that require it.

expiresInSeconds.description: KV overlay TTL. The Worker clamps values to 60 seconds through 8 hours.

data.description: Already-fetched upstream response body. Credential-shaped fields are redacted before archive storage.
